subject: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles

Team —

We go live on the Acme Cloud MAP kickoff with the customer on Wednesday 7/1 (10:00 PT). Before that, I want to lock down internal roles and the evaluation plan so we don’t get surprised mid-eval. Quick goals for this thread: 1) confirm RACI for MAP tasks, 2) tidy the evaluation checklist, 3) decide who will own procurement touchpoints during the legal review.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (high-level milestones), EvalChecklist-AcmeCloud.md (scoring rubric), RACI-roles-v2.pdf (proposal).

Proposed RACI highlights:
- Sales (I own executive sponsor & pricing cadence) — Account Exec
- Solution architecture & PoC validation — Monica (technical lead)
- Deployment/runbook & infra dependencies — Karthik (infra owner)
- Executive approvals & roadmap alignment — Marissa (customer success lead)
- Procurement & contract coordination — Laura (legal procurement partner)

Requests: please review the attachments and reply with any role objections or suggested changes by EOD Monday (6/29). If you see gaps in the evaluation checklist (e.g., data retention, audit logs, perf SLOs) call them out inline.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles

Ben — thanks. I reviewed MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and EvalChecklist. Two quick items from the technical side:

1) PoC scope: we should limit the initial PoC to a single API surface (chat generation) and one mid-size dataset to keep token costs predictable. Recommend calling out 3 scenarios (baseline, peak load, failure/retry) in the EvalChecklist.

2) Perf metrics: add 95th and 99th latency targets per region to the checklist — Acme will care about regional consistency. I can draft language and drop an updated EvalChecklist-AcmeCloud.md by EOD.

RACI: OK with me as technical lead. I’d like Karthik to be ‘R’ for infra readiness (networking, VPC peering), and I’ll be ‘A’ on feature acceptance.

Monica
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles

+1 to Monica. I’ll own infra readiness as R. Action items I’ll cover before kickoff:
- Validate VPC peering checklist (security group rules, route tables)
- Confirm test dataset ingress path and KV cache behavior with 3rd-party connector
- Smoke test a quantized 8-bit variant on their c5/gpu instance family and log token costs

I added a short note to RACI-roles-v2.pdf (see attached). No objections to the proposed owners otherwise.

Karthik
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles

Ben / team —

I skimmed the contract cadence and procurement questions in the MAP draft. Two notes: 1) Acme’s procurement expects a written SOC 2 in-scope statement and an audit timeline — do we have a clean doc to hand them? I can push the SOC2 statement to them, but will need legal sign-off. 2) Pricing: Acme has indicated they need a committed pricing option vs pay-as-you-go for the duration of evaluation. If we offer a 3-week committed test credit, I’ll need a dated email from finance approving credit.

I’ll own the procurement thread during kickoff and will be on the All Hands call 7/1. Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: MAP kickoff — Acme Cloud evaluation & roles

Thanks all — this is great and exactly the clarity we need. Summary / next steps before Wed 7/1 kickoff (10:00 PT):
- Monica: finalize EvalChecklist-AcmeCloud.md with regional 95/99 latency SLOs and the 3 scenario PoC scope (deliver by EOD 6/30).
- Karthik: infra readiness checklist + smoke test results (deliver by 7/1 08:00 PT).
- Laura: procurement contact established, SOC2 statement to Acme, and finance note on trial credits (deliver by 7/1 09:00 PT).
- Marissa: you’ll lead the kickoff and run the MAP walk-through with Acme — please prepare the one-pager on success metrics and escalation path.

Elena, looping you in so you have internal contacts: Monica (solutions/technical), Karthik (infra), Laura (contracts), Marissa (CS). We’ll share the MAP file and the EvalChecklist in the drive before the meeting. Agenda for the call (30m): intros, MAP timeline, PoC scope, procurement filter, next milestones.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0189

-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmecloud.com>
Sent: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Re: availability

Ben —

Thanks for the intro and for the fast turnaround internally. I’ve shared the kickoff invite with procurement and the security stakeholders. We’d like the PoC to include a short reliability test (5-minute burst, 2x expected QPS) to validate autoscaling behavior. Also, a note that our CISO expects a short runbook for incident response during the PoC.

See you Wednesday.

Elena Rossi
Director, Cloud Platforms | Acme Cloud
elena.rossi@acmecloud.com
